display_name: Federal Reserve Regulation W: transactions between member banks and their affiliates
citation: 12 CFR Part 223 — Transactions Between Member Banks and Their Affiliates (Regulation W)
authority: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

source.note: US federal regulation, a work of the United States Government and not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105); see SOURCE-LICENSE.md. The Part 223 slice of the annual edition revised as of January 1, 2025 is deposited under source/; source/part223.source.json pins the volume and the slice by sha256.

encodings_note: TWO ENCODINGS, BOTH PARTIAL, the second built on the first. 'affiliates-2026-11' covers the definition of affiliate in 12 CFR 223.2 and the definitions of company, person, subsidiary and control in 12 CFR 223.3. 'transactions-2026-11' covers covered transactions and credit transactions (223.3(h), (i)), the 10 and 20 percent limits (223.11, 223.12), safety and soundness as a stated judgement (223.13), collateral (223.14), low-quality assets (223.15), attribution (223.16), valuation (223.21(a), 223.22 to 223.24) and the exemptions (223.41, 223.42); it takes who is an affiliate from byte copies of the affiliates row's modules, because the stable l4 resolves IMPORT only within the importing file's folder. Not encoded, as the two rows' NOTES.md files list it: investment-fund and merchant-banking affiliates (223.2(a)(6), (a)(9)), the sequence and timing rules (223.21(b), 223.22(b)(2), 223.23(b)(2)), section 23B (223.43, 223.51 to 223.56), and 223.31 to 223.33, 223.61, 223.71 and 223.72. No domain expert has read either row against the source. Each row's open questions are in its registers/fork-register.json.
